summary: Cavite 5th District representative with 57 principal-authored bills. Authored higher teacher salary grades, a cut in the PhilHealth premium rate and an extended corporate life and powers for the PITC. Co-authored LPG price protection, zero petroleum excise, a plastic-bag excise, estate tax amnesty, travel-tax abolition and a bill criminalizing online fake news.
caveat: Fake-news bill is a single co-authored speech issue and civil liberties is unscored. Items pull in both directions, so the score is neutral.

economic.label: Center / mixed
economic.rationale: Authored teacher salary upgrades (-2) and PITC expansion (-1) against a PhilHealth premium cut (+2); co-authored LPG consumer price protection (-2) against zero petroleum excise and estate tax amnesty (+1 to +2).
